hook.line: Five things you need to do immediately when you start using Claude.
hook.visual: Face close-up, hand held up showing five fingers, Claude logo card and orange '5 Things To Do Immediately With Claude' title on top

beats.what: Open on face with five fingers raised, Claude logo and orange title card above
Cut to a new face shot with a 'Comment Claude for my full guide' orange label: CTA up front
Series framing: 'day 16 of the valuable AI series' to build a recurring habit
Cut to phone filming his monitor; orange '1. Turn on Claude Memory' step label
Memory import pro tip from ChatGPT shown on the settings screen
Step three: a course website, URL shown in a white label at top
Zoom punch into the screen as he pastes the course URL into a prompt
Step four: personal preferences screen, plus a second 'comment human' keyword offer
Step five: Cowork dispatch toggle on the monitor
Back to face with 'Comment Claude for the full guide' label for the closing CTA

why_it_works: Numbered list promised in the first second with fingers and a title, so viewers know the length and stay to reach number five
Comment-keyword offer (a free guide) at 12 s and again at the end turns viewers into comments, which feeds distribution
Each step is a real setting shown on a real screen, so it can be copied right away and gets saved
Orange numbered step labels at the top keep the viewer oriented while the screen changes
weaknesses: Two minutes long with long screen shots (longest 30.7 s) and few cuts; the middle drags
Filming a monitor with a phone makes the UI small and hard to read on mobile
Two different comment keywords ('Claude' and 'human') split the ask
for_robert: Use a numbered step label that changes per step and a single comment-keyword offer early; Fred could hold up the step number card at each new step.
